description: Can you predict what a recursive function returns without running it? Spot why one loop is O(n log n)? Pick the right data structure in a second? Dry Run is a fast, focused test of the fundamentals every coding interview leans on. It's no-IDE and no-compiler: just you, the logic and 25 minutes. Rules and guidelines: Individual participation. Open to UG and PG students from any stream. One attempt only, with a continuous 25-minute timer. Start by 9:35 PM IST on 12 December to get the full 25 minutes. The assessment closes at 10:00 PM IST. All questions are objective (four options, one correct). There are no executable coding problems. Code snippets are in simple Python. Pen and paper for rough work are allowed. Running the code in an IDE, compiler or online tool, or using AI assistants, is not allowed. 5 marks per correct answer, no negative marking. Total 100. Ties are broken by more correct answers on the hardest questions, then less time taken, then earlier submission. Sharing questions or answers during the window leads to disqualification. Stay on the assessment screen. The organisers' decision is final.
